title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 14 expands the grounded river ecology, redistributes fauna through the foreground depth corridor, improves close-range canopy readability, and adds authored water-garden detail without removing the resident network, route tunnels, landmarks, construction, mission finale, or weather cycle.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the production bundle completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: the ground ecology expands from eight to twelve distinct high-quality species: red-eyed tree frog, emerald iguana, lowland tapir, white-faced capuchin, keel-billed toucan, Amazon river turtle, golden poison-dart frog, ring-tailed coati, golden jaguar, greater capybara, spectacled caiman, and brown-throated sloth
fauna are redistributed from the inner promenade through the middle river banks and out toward the catch pool, preserving a seven-unit minimum radius around the protected route

frog hops, basking turns, forest-floor gait, branch sway, perch hops, river drift, predator prowl, and wetland wading run in the shared terrain shader and settle into authored poses under reduced-motion settings
monkey, toucan, and sloth receive real branch and moss-perch geometry so elevated species read as habitat residents rather than suspended props
fauna receive a restrained shader-only visibility lift while remaining vertex-colored geometry inside the existing basin mesh
the procedural canopy-volume crowns use smaller mobile point footprints and brighter leaf response, reducing dark close-camera occlusion without removing jungle density
twelve solid lily pads, five raised lotus buds, and nine nested torus ripples layer the foreground catch pool with no image cards and no additional draw calls
deterministic fauna-left, fauna-right, broad-fauna, motion-a, and motion-b QA states expose placement and movement for repeatable phone-scale review

all prior resident work loops, route tunnels, landmark builds, Living Compass mission choreography, Emerald Zenith finale, weather phases, weighted lightning, and storm practical lighting remain intact

evidence.proves: the ordinary clear-day gameplay framing retains the Lost City hierarchy while the stream, catch pool, lily field, ripples, residents, and layered jungle remain readable together on the production narrow-phone surface
the deterministic right-bank ecology view shows fauna distributed from the inhabited ruin edge into the outer foreground rather than overlapping in one inner-ring cluster

knownCaptureNotes: The source image remains a visual reference only and is not rendered in Island 018.
The captures retain the real workbench chrome because they verify the production narrow-phone authoring surface and its 7/7 release gate.
Pass 14 inherits the complete Pass 13 weather and practical-light evidence plus earlier landmark, tunnel, construction, mission, resident, water, and Emerald Zenith proof.
The active 10/10 production goal remains open until player visual judgment validates the island.
